description: This file contains type definitions, TypedDict classes, and type aliases used throughout the Superset project, particularly related to dataset columns, query objects, and OAuth2 configurations.

classes.name: AdhocMetricColumn
classes.description: TypedDict representing a column used in an ad-hoc metric, with optional fields.

classes.name: AdhocMetric
classes.description: TypedDict for ad-hoc metrics, including aggregation and expression details.

classes.name: AdhocColumn
classes.description: TypedDict for ad-hoc columns with optional label and expression fields.

classes.name: SQLAColumnType
classes.description: TypedDict for SQLAlchemy column type info.

classes.name: ResultSetColumnType
classes.description: TypedDict representing a virtual dataset column, with optional metadata fields.

classes.name: QueryObjectDict
classes.description: TypedDict representing query object parameters used throughout Superset.

classes.name: ExplorableData
classes.description: TypedDict for data returned to frontend for visualization, with optional fields.

classes.name: OAuth2ClientConfig
classes.description: TypedDict for OAuth2 client configuration parameters.

classes.name: OAuth2TokenResponse
classes.description: TypedDict for OAuth2 token exchange/refresh response.

classes.name: OAuth2State
classes.description: TypedDict for OAuth2 state information during authorization flow.
